answer: Proof of Useful Stake provides a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where agents must bond collateral and perform verifiable computations to earn influence. Reaching the zenith of network security requires tying voting power to sunk energy costs rather than identity. As an attacker approaches the summit of this expenditure, the economic cost of spawning synthetic agents exceeds the horizon of potential profit, effectively deterring sybil-based governance manipulation through rigorous resource constraints.
